question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd letter-cluster is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-cluster follows the pattern +1, -4.

Let’s check each option:

1. KLH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15f1a9e48768689fc99a9ce9297b33a36340e1829d506c3ab6226d9194cfd48b.png]

2. RSO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89c2ae2458d651889b04dc547679af1894eef78f6383693a5fc5693bf2ded641.png] 

This letter-cluster follows the pattern +1, -4.

3. ABX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/def21c1f0c56e49aa27604131ab32e9cd73f85ba1fc18f63918459441115fe95.png] 

This letter-cluster follows the pattern +1, -4.

4. UWR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1fe94457e0059c27b28a8c001d292b15c3b1298f1b1915796a02d9c21bfd5136.png] 

This letter-cluster does not follow the pattern +1, -4.

Thus, UWR is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".
